scope: Local-only compiled Mainnet-bytecode VM tests; no network transactions, program deployment, signer change or Mainnet approval.
runnerNote: The build and all 11 tests completed successfully. A trailing Windows carriage return in the temporary shell wrapper caused a later command-not-found exit after the success summary and binary hash; this was not a build or test failure.
finding: The operator could choose a genuine automation record and redirect uncapped referral categories 2-4 without creator consent.
correction: Mainnet categories 2-4 require a creator signature at approval and payment. The operations automation path and Devnet authorization behavior remain unchanged.
assertions: Operator-only approvals and payments rejected for every referral tier
Rejected attempts preserve tracked balances, approval and withdrawal state
Creator-signed payments deliver exact simulated vault and recipient balance deltas
Duplicate payments rejected without state changes
